notes.title: Difficulty levels!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players![/b][/h1]

[h1]It's been a while since the release of our game ⏰[/h1]

[h3]Thank you for your support, suggestions and help you have given us in recent weeks 💝.
[/h3]
After reading many of your comments, reviews, messages on Disord and emails, we have decided to introduce a brand new feature to Our Pets Hotel game. [b]These will be difficulty levels! 🥳
[/b]
We came to the conclusion that our game should satisfy as many players as possible, and after all, each of you is different 😀 Some people prefer a quieter and very relaxing gameplay, while someone else is constantly looking for new challenges to tackle 💪.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/86e505d9e6ef1e9f7413adad0d58f09dd5cf97f6.png[/img]

[h2][b]Difficulty levels:[/b][/h2]

[b]Easy 🟢[/b]
The pets' needs bar fall slowly 📉 and the games satisfy them much quicker which allows us to devote enough time to each pet admitted to our hotel 🐈
Plus, the staff walk very quickly, no matter what skill level they have! 🏃
At the start of your business the rooms are more expensive and you can increase the price much more as your reputation increases 💰


[b]Medium 🟡 [/b]
The game will function as before. The walking speed of the workers increases with their lvl, the pet needs bar goes down and up at a moderate speed and the rooms are slightly cheaper at the start 🙂


[b]Hard 🔴[/b]
Challenging level! Earnings remain normal, employees work as fast as their level allows, animal needs grow much faster, just as they grow much faster by skipping a day earlier ⏬❗

[h2][b]
Other fixes introduced with this update : [/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] blocked possibility to set the room price to "0"
[/list]

[h3][b]We hope that these changes will allow each of our players to enjoy playing and running their own pet hotel 🎉.

Let us know what you think about this in the comments below this post and on our discord 👇[/b][/h3]

[url=https://discord.gg/SC9YtyErJX][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/499b0e19ebc4818f23539ef68e19093f7bd8f660.png[/img][/url]

Have fun!
Pets Hotel Team

notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Managers! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h2]Today, we’d like to bring you some new information 📝 about one of the animal statuses in the game - [b]FUN![/b].[/h2]

[h3]But but but… Before we get into today's devlog topic, if you somehow missed the information about the [b]upcoming premiere[/b], then mark your calendar now - [b]April 12, 2023, 3:00 PM CEST![/b] 📅[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/d9259c749adaea4ee08e89c2fb0b1e5e1357b5ec.gif[/img]

As you already know, [b]entertaining[/b] your lovely animal guests ⚾🐕 is [b]an important part[/b] of running your Pets Hotel, as it [b]satisfies their desire to play[/b]. 🐱 Therefore, we present you a [b]new interactive toys[/b] for the animals! 🤩

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/f7fdea720b7a124e12d6531026676af189ba9f72.gif[/img]

[h3]They can be placed in the [b]individual rooms[/b], or a [b]bigger playground[/b] 🧸 for all your guests can be created to [b]satisfy even the pickiest ones[/b].😀 After all, not every guest will be interested in large or medium rooms that have enough space to accommodate all the toys in them. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/e56fc038452daca8e83a6a43e5d203ee84412b63.gif[/img]

[h2]Remember, the more guests you take in at the same time, the less time ⏲️ you have to spend with each of them. That’s why[b] the toys[/b] we show you are [b]bound to become[/b] an [b]invaluable asset[/b] in your hotels. 🐾[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/092651d5ca4624682855dd36099d744db4b600bb.gif[/img]

[h3]You know what the best part is? There are [b]EVEN MORE TOYS[/b] to choose from and each of them has its own [b]unique interactions[/b] with the animals! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/6e328ce2800d7654473958392427605ff823c8a5.gif[/img]

[b]We greatly appreciate all your comments, suggestions and ideas[/b] 💬 about the contents of the game so don’t forget to[b] join our discord[/b] 👇community where you can talk with the developers and [b]add the game to your wishlist[/b] 👇so you so you won't miss the [b]upcoming launch on April 12[/b]!! 🙂

notes.title: Stroking pets
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello dear players! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]How are you all doing? We hope that after releasing the PROLOGUE of our [b]Pets Hotel[/b], you have as much positive energy and willingness to act as we do 🎉 .

As we have mentioned to you more than once and more than twice - the stage of releasing the DEMO version or Prologue of the game, gives us an extraordinary opportunity to collect your opinions and suggestions on our projects 📝, [b]and this in turn makes it possible for us to develop them and meet your expectations.[/b]

And this time was no different! Based on your suggestions and requests, among others, we created a brand [b]new pet stroking system[/b] ❣️ 🐶[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/a25259666322dbd49c5b4313d8d06117d82c5a6c.png[/img]


[h2][b]Pet stroking at our pet hotel 🐈‍[/b][/h2]

Stroking the pets we take care of in place of their owners is [b]very important[/b] to ensure their well-being, a sense of security and helps build a proper bond with them 💝

Until now, this mechanic, has been less engaging for you - the players, but you have given us a clear signal that you would like to have more freedom during these activities. Therefore, we have created a completely new version of this mechanic in the game that is more engaging for you - stroking will be done manually, through the use of the computer's mouse and, consequently, our hand in the game 👏


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/39b5792fd298a296e589e1189f4fb709ba5a4d55.png[/img]


[b]We hope that this treatment will make the game even more rewarding for you![/b]


[h2][b]Along with the new mechanics in the game, there are also brand new character traits for pets! 
 🤗[/b][/h2]

As pet-loving people, we know very well that some pets like stroking more others less, and at the same time some pets respond extremely positively to petting from their owner. [b]Due to the expansion of stroking mechanics in Pets Hotel[/b], we have also added brand new pet features ❗❗

[h3][b]Additional features provided for dogs and kittens : [/b][/h3]

[b]🐶 Likes stroking on the head (applies to dogs and cats)
🐈 Likes stroking on the back (applies to dogs and cats)
😆 Likes stroking on tummy (applies to dogs)[/b]



[b]Pets with these character traits will be quicker to fill all of their stat bars, but either way, every pet will enjoy being petted![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/7dcedf968d89e1645785b874c0741eca9b2e5efc.png[/img]


[h3][b]These are not all the changes we have planned and taken into account, so look forward to the full version of the game~![/b][/h3]




[h2][b]Join us on our Discord so that you can talk to the Game Developers about the news of the Pets Hotel game and other players interested in similar topics![/b][/h2]

[url=https://discord.gg/SC9YtyErJX][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/499b0e19ebc4818f23539ef68e19093f7bd8f660.png[/img][/url]


[h2][b]Also, add our game to Wishlist to stay up to date with all the news related to this project!
[/b][/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714250/Pets_Hotel/


[b]See You soon,
Pets Hotel Team[/b]

notes.title: Massaging the Hotel guests! 😺
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Pets Hotel Owners![/b] 🐶[/h1]
Today we are gonna go over the [b]massage[/b] service you will be able to provide for your favorite animals!🐢❤

[h1][b]Massage[/b]🥰[/h1]
[b]Masseuses[/b] need to be called in to their [b]stations[/b] every time there is a job for them📞

Items used only by your workers will be marked accordingly in the shop🎀

If you have 10 [b]pets[/b] and 6 of them have to be [b]massaged[/b] you will need to call a specialist for the job to take care of the [b]pets[/b] one by one.👩‍🏫

Everything to make your [b]pets[/b] feel loved and cared for🥰

[h1][b]Special service[/b]💅🏻[/h1]
When the client calls there is going to be a window that will appear, informing you about the details of an animal and displaying an additional service like a [b]massage[/b]🙀 that the client may want to be performed.🤳

If the player bought [b]equipment[/b] letting him do that service he can accept the [b]pet[/b].💲✅

For the special [b]service[/b] you have to buy [b]special equipment[/b] and set it up in its designated place.👨‍🏫

notes.title: Resting employers, terrariums and aquariums! 🐟
notes.content:
[h1]Hello [b]Hotel[/b] Managers! 👋[/h1]

One of the interesting game mechanics in Pets Hotel will be the ability to hire employees which will support us in everyday responsibilities in our hotel for pets. 😼


You will also be able to buy terrariums and aquariums!

Speaking of employees… Everyone needs a break! 😴 Our employees time to time need it too.
The game will offer several options for your employees to relax and take a break. It is up to you what equipment for employees will be available in your pet hotel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/371708c9cda090d08b03185145c23f758db2d975.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/7bdfe5ab7a49b9edcf84127391861c1391d80d3f.png[/img]

They can use water coolers 💧 coffee machines ☕ and microwaves. Using them all makes the rest time shorter than just sitting on a bench which is also part of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/635887f2fd3a7862e6a0f577ec9f9a36e5133db5.png[/img]

🚨WARNING 🚨
If you have equipped your pet hotel with microwaves, coffee machines or other facilities for employees, it does not mean that their rest time will increase significantly, everyone needs a moment to sit down and rest. 🛋️ Like Steve, Steve loves to take a break. 🤭

[h1]🐢[b]Terrariums & Aquariums[/b] 🐠[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/8193d67b020cf7099962c5ced482dbb4ea3aca5c.png[/img]

Terrariums and aquariums can be upgraded by paying money.💵

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/eb7ac813aa17a99b37eea5e56c2841a7a3613e5a.png[/img]
Another plus of having better, bigger, better-equipped terrariums and aquariums, make the animal feel better and it takes much longer for their needs to become problematic, which makes it easier to manage our guests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/3f679b839564d306744bd5ebf046af6f8073c69b.png[/img]

We hope you will have a lot of fun with your employees and items in the game! Let us know what you think about it in our [b]Discord[/b]! (link below) Don’t forget to wishlist the game to get a notification as soon as the game comes out!  ✨

[url=https://discord.gg/2jah8pmY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/499b0e19ebc4818f23539ef68e19093f7bd8f660.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714250/Pets_Hotel/

Bark to you soon!
The Pets Hotel Team

notes.title: Toys, pet beds and more
notes.content:
[h1][b]😻  Hello animal lovers! 😻[/b][/h1]

[h3]First of all, we wanted to thank you very much for your activity during the Steam Festival. It is thanks to you and your feedback on gameplay that we are able to take our Pets Hotel game in the right direction 🔥

We hope that in the near future our game will meet all your expectations and at the same time positively surprise you!

[b]Ending the introduction of our devlog, we invite you to read the latest news from the game Pest Hotel![/b][/h3]



[h2][b]Great lounging places for our pets![/b][/h2]

As we all know, pets, depending on the species, have many preferences. Those nutritional and those strictly related to places for sleeping 💤 and playing.

In our game, we want to reflect as well as possible all the specific behaviors of our animal hotel guests. That's why, in addition to the wonderful, soft beds you had a chance to see in the demo of our game, [b]scratching posts[/b] and much more will be available for our pets!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/2842cee3bdfb8706a22dee998aec02387df62ff3.png[/img]


Scratchers will be objects that we will be able to place in any room we choose intended for pets, to make their time spent without their beloved owners more pleasant. Cats, among others, will be able to [b]sleep on each level of the scratcher[/b], maintaining their nature of observers in love with high hiding places and also sharpen their claws on specially prepared scratchers 🐈


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/30468d25a7fe4d9a9fe8d6adc1654d49bbaffd2d.png[/img]




[h2][b]Animals take care of themselves?  🩹[/b][/h2]

Well, rather! No different. When running a pet hotel, we often have to divide our attention between all our animal guests. Despite the sincerest desire to be with them 24 hours a day - this will not always be feasible. ⏰


That's why we have stocked our game with sensory toys that pets can play with on their own! We already have amazing[b] toys in the plans, such as electric laser toys, various types of mice and balls 
 ⚾[/b]. 

[b]Remember, an amused pet is a happy pet! [/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/b1411a35ec1e5ef6db218bca094d5d252c049453.png[/img]



[i]Question for the attentive :
What toys do your pets most like to play with? ❤️[/i]



[h3]We hope that the objects we are adding to the game will help you get a better feel for the role of an Animal Hotel owner. If you would like to share with us your ideas that you would like to see in our game, we invite you to join our Discord. There you can chat with the game's creators, but also meet other players who love animals!  🤝[/h3]

[url=https://discord.gg/SC9YtyErJX][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/499b0e19ebc4818f23539ef68e19093f7bd8f660.png[/img][/url]


[h3]
Don't forget to add the Pets Hotel game to your Wishlist to stay up to date with more new developments coming in gameplay!
[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714250/Pets_Hotel/



See You soon,
Pets Hotel Team

notes.title: DEVLOG #6 | Weather
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Pet Hotel Owners! [/b]🐶[/h1]

[h3]Thank you for the large number of messages and positive reactions under the previous devlog and on our [url=https://discord.gg/SC9YtyErJX]DISCORD[/url]! This gives us a lot of positive energy to continue working on our Pets Hotel game. 🥰[/h3]

[h3]Today we want to tell you about a very unusual aspect of our game, which is Weather Change. ☀️☁️🌧️[/h3]

Yes, during your game you will have another challenge to face!

Changing weather conditions implemented into our game was quite a programming challenge for us, as we wanted to give you not only a great visual experience but also additional gameplay elements. 

In the end, we succeeded, and all your pet hotel guests will react to the changing weather!

[h3][b]The following weather conditions will appear in the game:[/b][/h3]
[h3]☀️ Sunny
🌤️ Partly cloudy
☁️ Cloudiness
🌫️ Fog
🌧️ Rain
⛈️ Storm[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/44d92dcc62eba5831ca3546995dd7f5c14174ad7.png[/img]

From now on, you will have to pay attention to the behavior, needs, fears and preferences of your guests in your pet hotel.

During sunny ☀️ weather, pets will be raring to go for a walk, while during cloudy ☁️ days they will be less eager to joyfully jump on the lawn after a ball. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/559eafa9f171247d16f4f9c58df9314b62c7ab34.png[/img]



In addition, you have to remember that some pets really like jumping in puddles in the rain and others won't stick their noses out on the threshold of the hotel ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/ae63f45079a6aa28f45988da12f3778a8cedeb4d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/699771b70ef2c98d2eea203934ebc1c657ed5086.png[/img]



You will need special care for those guests of the pet hotel who are panically afraid of thunderstorms! ⛈️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/16829e8d17d25f4e93535f423ec5e8fecfa07ceb.jpg[/img]



Remember that all pets in our hotel temporarily and have their beloved owners, who will be very scrupulous to check how their pet is doing and whether it received proper care and attention during its stay with you. 

What do you think about the changes in weather conditions in our Pets Hotel game? Let us know in the comments below the post or on our DISCORD
[url=https://discord.gg/SC9YtyErJX][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/499b0e19ebc4818f23539ef68e19093f7bd8f660.png[/img][/url]

Add our game to your Steam Wishlist to stay up to date with all the news! And believe us, it will be happening ;)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714250/Pets_Hotel/

See You soon,
Pets Hotel Team
